fonts.display: 'Exposure30', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'Geist', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Ink Black
palette.role: Primary text, filled action buttons, dark surfaces — warm near-black replaces pure black so the entire palette feels printed on cream rather than rendered on glass

palette.name: Paper White
palette.role: Card surfaces, button text on dark fills — the only true white in the system, reserved for elements that need to lift off the warm canvas

palette.name: Canvas Cream
palette.role: Page background — the dominant warm neutral that makes the entire site feel like uncoated stock paper rather than a screen

palette.name: Linen
palette.role: Nav bar background, subtle section alternation, heading hairlines — a lighter cream that layers on the canvas without breaking warmth

palette.name: Stone
palette.role: Muted text, input borders, heading underlines — warm gray for secondary information that should recede into the paper

palette.name: Hairline
palette.role: Link underlines, card borders, subtle dividers — the lightest warm border, almost invisible against the canvas

palette.name: Espresso
palette.role: Dark surface accent, input fills — slightly lighter than Ink Black for the announcement bar and secondary dark surfaces

palette.name: Charcoal
palette.role: SVG icon fills, pure black instances — used sparingly in vector icons where absolute black is needed

palette.name: Cobblestone
palette.role: Secondary border, decorative dividers — warmer than Hairline, used for borders that need slightly more presence

palette.name: Highlighter Orange
palette.role: Accent for links, icon strokes, outlined callouts — vivid warm orange that only outlines, never fills, keeping the energy of a marker on paper rather than a UI button
